desc: A custom single-pass post effect with intensity, progress, blur, and lighting controls.

preset.name: none
preset.desc: Disables the stylization and preserves the source image as much as possible.

subProperties.name: intensity
subProperties.desc: Overall effect-strength control intended for simple host-side animation or mixing.

subProperties.name: ratio
subProperties.desc: Ratio parameter used to balance or scale the custom effect response.

subProperties.name: progress
subProperties.desc: Normalized progress control for animating the effect over time.

subProperties.name: blurSize
subProperties.desc: Parameter controlling blurSize in the LumiCustom effect.

subProperties.name: quality
subProperties.desc: Internal quality or downsampling control that trades detail for performance.

subProperties.name: lightIntensity
subProperties.desc: Additional light or highlight intensity used by the custom shader.
